qualification_rule: held-out execution is permitted only if the frozen critical function contains at least one feasible rho and both an infeasible low-rho and infeasible high-rho witness
information_contract: Each delivered edge carries timestamped position, velocity, actuator state, previously applied command, heterogeneous beta/drag/tau and declared trim; a deterministic refresh is forced after one missed scheduled update.
prohibited: No held-out seed may be read before this contract and the V5 parameter contract are frozen.
No parameter or threshold may be changed after held-out execution.
An empty predicted window is a failed promotion, not evidence of a critical window.
